DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)

The imaging and spirometry results showing a restrictive pattern (low FVC, low FEV1/FVC ratio) combined with bilateral interstitial markings are highly characteristic of pulmonary fibrosis. Given your lack of smoking history or specific occupational exposures mentioned, this points toward an idiopathic cause. Do you have any family history of lung disease, and have you noticed any dry, "crackling" sounds in your chest?
